# Queen of the Ring (rap battle league)

Queen of the Ring (QOTR) is a women's battle rap league. The series has approximately 41 million YouTube views and around 183k subscribers since its founding in August 2010. Founders Debo and Vague said they created Queen of the Ring as a spinoff of King Of The Ring, which is a tournament for aspiring battle rappers where the winner is secured a spot in the industry leading Ultimate Rap League.
